title: Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals
title_zh: 利用用户手册使计算机使用智能体适应新软件

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have significantly improved the ability to operate real-world software through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using visual observations and natural language instructions. However, maintaining strong performance on unseen applications remains challenging, as practical tasks often require long-horizon procedural knowledge and application-specific operation patterns. In addition, constructing executable tasks and collecting corresponding trajectories for training still heavily rely on human-annotated data, incurring substantial cost. In this paper, we propose MAGE (Manual-augmented computer use AG ent E xecution and learning), a framework that leverages user manuals as a scalable source of procedural knowledge to improve both inference and training. During execution, MAGE retrieves task-relevant manual content and uses a planner to generate explicit procedural guidance for CUAs. To further account for the discrepancies between manuals and actual GUI environments, such as version differences or user settings, MAGE also adapts the agent policy through environment interaction. During training, MAGE converts manuals into executable task-plan pairs and uses the plans to guide environment rollouts toward task-relevant states; the resulting trajectories are then used to optimize the policy without human-authored demonstrations. This unified design enables effective utilization of manuals for both task execution and training, reducing reliance on human-authored training data. Experimental results across six applications demonstrate improvements in task success rates over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of manual-guided planning and policy adaptation in new software environments. We provide the code and reproduction scripts at https://github.com/ku-autoai/MAGE.git .

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) ( Yin et al., 2024 ) have enabled Computer Use Agents (CUAs) ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) to operate software from visual observations and natural language instructions. Unlike conventional automation methods that rely on APIs or HTML structures, these agents interact directly with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in a human-like manner. This enables CUAs to perform various tasks across diverse software environments.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展（Yin et al., 2024）使得计算机使用智能体（CUAs）（Zhang et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2024；Qin et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025）能够根据视觉观察和自然语言指令来操作软件。 与依赖 API 或 HTML 结构的传统自动化方法不同，这些智能体以类似人类的方式直接与图形用户界面（GUI）交互。 这使得 CUAs 能够在多样化的软件环境中执行各种任务。

sents.en: This enables CUAs to perform various tasks across diverse software environments.
sents.zh: 这使得 CUAs 能够在多样化的软件环境中执行各种任务。

paragraphs.en: However, existing CUAs require additional training to maintain high performance on unfamiliar applications since each application has its own interface and functionalities. Existing adaptation ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) typically relies on costly human annotations to define diverse executable tasks and collect corresponding action trajectories. Although reinforcement learning ( Sutton et al., 1998 ; Silver and Sutton, 2025 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) can reduce the need for human demonstrations, GUI tasks are inherently long-horizon: agents should sequentially uncover available options through clicks, menus, and dialogs rather than observing all relevant information at once. This makes it difficult to obtain sufficient successful trajectories, limiting the training signals required to improve the agent policy.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的 CUA 需要额外的训练才能在不熟悉的应用上保持高性能，因为每个应用都有各自的界面和功能。 现有的适配方法（Qin et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025a; Yuan et al., 2025）通常依赖昂贵的人工标注来定义多样的可执行任务并收集相应的动作轨迹。 尽管强化学习（Sutton et al., 1998; Silver and Sutton, 2025; Shao et al., 2024）可以减少对人工示范的依赖，但 GUI 任务本质上是长程的：智能体需要通过点击、菜单和对话框逐步探索可用选项，而不是一次性观察到所有相关信息。 这使得获取足够的成功轨迹变得困难，进而限制了改进智能体策略所需的训练信号。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we leverage user manuals as a source of procedural supervision. Manuals describe application functionalities and the procedures required to execute them, including functions hidden behind menus, dialogs, and toolbars. By exposing access routes to such functions, manuals can reduce unguided exploration in long-horizon GUI tasks. Prior approaches have also leveraged external knowledge, such as web tutorials and past interaction experiences, to guide GUI agents ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Agashe et al., 2025 ) . However, providing external knowledge only during execution does not directly address the challenge of collecting successful trajectories for policy adaptation. Moreover, manuals may be abstract or differ from actual GUI environments due to software versions, user settings, or access permissions. Thus, agents must ground procedural guidance through environment interaction and learn which actions succeed in the current GUI state.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们利用用户手册作为程序性监督的来源。 手册描述了应用程序的功能以及执行这些功能所需的操作步骤，包括隐藏在菜单、对话框和工具栏背后的功能。 通过揭示访问这些功能的路径，手册可以减少智能体在长程 GUI 任务中无引导的探索。 已有研究也曾利用外部知识（如网络教程和过往交互经验）来引导 GUI 智能体（Xu et al., 2025a；Agashe et al., 2025）。 然而，仅在执行过程中提供外部知识，并不能直接解决为策略自适应收集成功轨迹的难题。 此外，由于软件版本、用户设置或访问权限的差异，手册可能较为抽象或与实际 GUI 环境不一致。 因此，智能体必须通过与环境交互来落实程序性指导，并学习在当前 GUI 状态下哪些操作能够成功。

paragraphs.en: Based on this observation, we propose MAGE (Manual-augmented computer use AG ent E xecution and learning), a unified framework that leverages user manuals to improve both execution-time planning and training-time policy optimization. During execution, MAGE retrieves task-relevant manual content and uses a planner to generate task-specific procedural plans that guide CUAs. During training, it automatically generates diverse executable tasks and corresponding plans from user manuals. Rather than treating generated plans as expert demonstrations, MAGE evaluates the collected trajectories and optimizes the agent policy using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). This joint use of manuals for planning and policy learning enables application-specific adaptation without human-authored demonstrations or step-level action annotations.

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下。

paragraphs.en: We propose MAGE, a unified framework that uses user manuals as procedural supervision for both execution-time planning and training-time policy learning, combining a planner with CUAs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MAGE，一个统一框架，它将用户手册作为程序化监督，同时用于执行时规划与训练时策略学习，将规划器与 CUA 相结合。

paragraphs.en: We introduce retrieval-augmented planning, which retrieves task-relevant manual content and generates procedural plans to guide long-horizon GUI execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出检索增强规划，它检索与任务相关的手册内容并生成程序化计划，以指导长时程的图形用户界面（GUI）执行。

paragraphs.en: We develop a manual-derived training method that constructs task-plan pairs and optimizes the policy from the resulting trajectories without human-authored demonstrations or step-level annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于手册的训练方法，该方法构建任务-计划对，并从生成的轨迹中优化策略，无需人工编写的演示或步骤级标注。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MAGE across six applications and demonstrate improvements in task success rates over the corresponding baselines, examining the contributions of manual-guided planning and policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在六个应用上评估了 MAGE，并展示了其在任务成功率上相对相应基线的改进，同时考察了人工引导规划与策略优化各自的贡献。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate reliance on specific interfaces or predefined structural representations in computer environments, VLM-based agents that understand GUIs purely from visual signals have been proposed, with representative examples including OpenCUA ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and UI-TARS ( Qin et al., 2025 ) . Training these foundation models requires large and diverse datasets. For instance, OpenCUA ( Wang et al., 2025 ) integrates datasets from prior works such as ShowUI ( Lin et al., 2024 ) and UGround ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , along with general supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data from the Kimi Team ( Team et al., 2025 ) , and further incorporates demonstration data collected from Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS environments. Similarly, UI-TARS ( Qin et al., 2025 ) constructs additional training data by allowing human annotators to refine and correct trajectories generated by the model. While such data-centric training strategies significantly improve model performance, adapting these models to new software environments requires additional data collection and annotation tailored to each target domain. This process incurs substantial cost, thereby limiting the scalability and practical applicability of CUAs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解对特定接口或预定义结构化表示的依赖，已有研究提出了纯粹从视觉信号理解图形用户界面（GUI）的基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体，代表性工作包括 OpenCUA（Wang et al., 2025）和 UI-TARS（Qin et al., 2025）。 训练这些基础模型需要大规模且多样化的数据集。 例如，OpenCUA（Wang et al., 2025）整合了来自 ShowUI（Lin et al., 2024）和 UGround（Qian et al., 2025）等先前工作的数据集，并结合来自 Kimi Team（Team et al., 2025）的通用监督微调（SFT）数据，还进一步纳入了在 Ubuntu、Windows 和 macOS 环境中收集的演示数据。 类似地，UI-TARS（Qin et al., 2025）通过让人工标注者对模型生成的轨迹进行修正和完善，构建了额外的训练数据。 尽管这种以数据为中心的训练策略显著提升了模型性能，但将这些模型适配到新的软件环境时，需要针对每个目标领域进行额外的数据收集和标注。 这一过程成本高昂，从而限制了计算机使用智能体（CUA）的可扩展性和实际适用性。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has explored reducing human supervision for CUA adaptation by augmenting or reusing existing datasets for training, or by leveraging external knowledge to guide task execution. BTL-UI ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) augments existing datasets with ROI annotations, while ZeroGUI ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and DART ( Li et al., 2025 ) leverage benchmark-derived tasks for reinforcement learning. Meanwhile, RAG-GUI ( Xu et al., 2025a ) trains a VLM to generate guidelines from web tutorials, guiding a frozen CUA at inference time, and Agent S ( Agashe et al., 2025 ) uses external knowledge for hierarchical planning. However, data-driven approaches still rely on task-specific data, while knowledge-based approaches primarily assist execution at inference time without adapting the CUA’s policy. In contrast, MAGE leverages user manuals for both planning and policy optimization, improving task execution without repeatedly generating plans throughout an episode.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作通过扩充或复用现有数据集进行训练，或利用外部知识来指导任务执行，探索了减少 CUA 适应中人工监督的方法。 BTL-UI（Zhang et al., 2025a）用 ROI 标注扩充现有数据集，而 ZeroGUI（Yang et al., 2025）和 DART（Li et al., 2025）则利用源自基准测试的任务进行强化学习。 与此同时，RAG-GUI（Xu et al., 2025a）训练一个 VLM 从网页教程生成指南，在推理时指导一个冻结的 CUA，而 Agent S（Agashe et al., 2025）则使用外部知识进行分层规划。 然而，数据驱动的方法仍然依赖于任务特定的数据，而基于知识的方法主要在推理时辅助执行，却没有对 CUA 的策略进行适应。 相比之下，MAGE 利用用户手册同时进行规划和策略优化，无需在一个回合内反复生成计划即可提升任务执行效果。

paragraphs.en: MAGE is a manual-augmented adaptation framework for CUAs. Given a target program and its user manual, MAGE uses the manual as procedural supervision in two complementary ways: it retrieves task-relevant instructions to guide long-horizon execution, and it generates executable task-plan pairs to support policy training. These two components address the main bottlenecks in GUI adaptation: reliable task execution and scalable collection of successful trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: MAGE 是一个面向 CUA 的手册增强适配框架。 给定一个目标程序及其用户手册，MAGE 以两种互补的方式将手册用作过程性监督：它检索与任务相关的指令以引导长时程执行，并生成可执行的任务-计划对以支持策略训练。 这两个组件解决了 GUI 适配中的主要瓶颈：可靠的任务执行和成功轨迹的可扩展收集。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented planning provides procedural guidance, but manuals do not fully specify the actual GUI state of a target environment. In addition, interface elements can be hidden, customized, or restricted depending on application settings, workspace configurations, and user permissions. Thus, even when a manual describes a valid procedure, the agent should learn how to execute it robustly in the observed environment. To address this problem, we utilize user manuals not only for execution-time planning but also for policy training.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 , the training pipeline consists of three stages: (1) task generation, (2) episode generation, and (3) policy optimization. In the first stage, MAGE uses the manual to construct a set of executable task-plan pairs. This stage is performed once before training begins. Second, the current policy executes these task-plan pairs in the target GUI environment to collect episodes. Third, the collected episodes are evaluated and used to optimize the policy via GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . The second and third stages are repeated iteratively, so that each updated policy produces new episodes for subsequent optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，训练流程由三个阶段组成：(1) 任务生成，(2) 回合生成，(3) 策略优化。 在第一阶段，MAGE 使用手册构建一组可执行的任务-计划对。 该阶段在训练开始前执行一次。 第二，当前策略在目标 GUI 环境中执行这些任务-计划对以收集回合。 第三，对收集到的回合进行评估，并通过 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）优化策略。 第二和第三阶段迭代重复进行，使得每次更新后的策略都能为后续优化生成新的回合。

paragraphs.en: For each manual section, MAGE uses both the textual content and images as inputs. paragraphs.en: By explicitly separating setup tasks, the framework can generate and execute diverse tasks without requiring manually prepared initial environments. The resulting setup and main tasks naturally involve common operations in the target program, such as entering values into spreadsheet cells or navigating application menus. Training on these tasks exposes the agent to frequently used program operations while covering diverse functionalities and usage procedures described in the manual. The prompt template for task generation is provided in Appendix F.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过显式地将准备工作与主任务分离，该框架无需人工准备初始环境即可生成并执行多样化的任务。 由此产生的准备任务和主任务自然涉及目标程序中的常见操作，例如在电子表格单元格中输入数值或浏览应用程序菜单。 在这些任务上进行训练，使智能体接触到高频使用的程序操作，同时覆盖说明手册中描述的多样化功能和使用流程。 任务生成的提示词模板见附录 F.1。

paragraphs.en: In this stage, trajectories are constructed by executing the generated task pairs in the GUI environment. The trajectory collection follows the interaction process described in Section 3.2 . When a setup task is included in a task pair, the agent first executes the setup task to configure the required GUI state, and proceeds to the main task only upon successful completion. If there is no setup task, the agent directly executes the main task from the initial state. Each task execution generates a trajectory τ = { ( o 1 , a 1 ) , ( o 2 , a 2 ) , … , ( o T , a T ) } \tau=\{(o_{1},a_{1}),(o_{2},a_{2}),\dots,(o_{T},a_{T})\} consisting of a sequence of observations and actions.

paragraphs.en: To determine task success, we adopt the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm and employ a vision-language model (VLM) as an evaluator. The evaluator assigns a binary success reward R success ∈ { 0 , 1 } R^{\mathrm{success}}\in\{0,1\} to each trajectory, where R success = 1 R^{\mathrm{success}}=1 if the task is judged as successful and R success = 0 R^{\mathrm{success}}=0 otherwise. However, prior work ( Yang et al., 2025 ) has shown that evaluating full trajectories can be unreliable, as important details may be overlooked and hallucinations may lead to incorrect judgments. To mitigate this issue, we determine task success from the task instruction and the last five screenshots of the trajectory. This design aims to reduce susceptibility to hallucinations and evaluation cost. We provide a detailed analysis of the evaluator in Appendix D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了判定任务是否成功，我们采用 LLM 作为评判者的范式，并使用一个视觉语言模型（VLM）作为评估器。 评估器为每条轨迹分配一个二元成功奖励 R^{\mathrm{success}}\in\{0,1\}，其中若任务被判定为成功则 R^{\mathrm{success}}=1，否则 R^{\mathrm{success}}=0。 然而，先前的工作（Yang 等，2025）已经表明，评估完整轨迹可能并不可靠，因为重要细节可能被忽略，且幻觉可能导致错误的判断。 为了缓解这一问题，我们根据任务指令和轨迹的最后五张截图来判定任务是否成功。 这一设计旨在降低对幻觉的易感性并减少评估成本。 我们在附录 D.3 中对评估器进行了详细分析。

paragraphs.en: For policy optimization, we construct training episodes from the collected task executions. Setup and main tasks are handled as separate training instances rather than being merged into a single trajectory. Accordingly, each task execution produces a separate training episode, defined as a tuple ( ℐ , 𝒫 , τ , R success ) (\mathcal{I},\mathcal{P},\tau,R^{\mathrm{success}}) . Each task is executed multiple times to collect a diverse set of episodes, which are subsequently used for GRPO-based policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 在策略优化方面，我们利用收集到的任务执行构建训练回合。 设置和主要任务被处理为相互独立的训练实例，而不是合并为单条轨迹。 因此，每次任务执行都会产生一个独立的训练回合，定义为一个元组 ( ℐ , 𝒫 , τ , R success ) (\mathcal{I},\mathcal{P},\tau,R^{\mathrm{success}}) 。 每个任务被执行多次，以收集多样的回合集合，这些回合随后用于基于 GRPO 的策略优化。

paragraphs.en: In our adaptation setting, the amount of interaction data and available computation are limited compared to general foundation model training. Thus, we utilize GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to optimize the CUA from collected episodes instead of using other reinforcement learning algorithms requiring a separate value model, such as PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的适配场景中，交互数据的数量和可用算力相较于通用基础模型训练都是有限的。 因此，我们利用 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization，组相对策略优化）(Shao et al., 2024) 来基于收集的回合数据优化智能体（CUA），而不是使用其他需要单独价值模型的强化学习算法，例如 PPO (Schulman et al., 2017)。

paragraphs.en: GRPO requires multiple rollouts per task to estimate group-level statistics, and learning becomes more effective as the proportion of episodes with positive rewards increases. However, generating new rollouts at every training step incurs substantial computational cost. We define a round as a cycle of episode generation and GRPO-based training. To address this, we propose a round-based training strategy that builds on an offline learning setup by reusing existing data while incrementally incorporating rollouts generated by the latest policy. In each round, newly generated episodes are added to the existing dataset and used for subsequent training. By repeating this process, rollouts with higher success rates are progressively collected, enabling the dataset to expand and the policy to improve over time.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 需要每个任务进行多次 rollout 以估计组级统计量，且正奖励片段的比例越高，学习效果越好。 然而，在每一步训练中都生成新的 rollout 会带来巨大的计算开销。 我们将一轮定义为由片段生成与基于 GRPO 的训练组成的一个循环。 为解决这一问题，我们提出一种基于轮次的训练策略，它在离线学习设置的基础上复用已有数据，同时逐步纳入由最新策略生成的 rollout。 在每一轮中，新生成的片段会被加入现有数据集，并用于后续训练。 通过重复这一过程，成功率更高的 rollout 会逐步被收集，使数据集得以扩展、策略随时间不断改进。

paragraphs.en: Instead of computing expectations over all episodes within a group, we adopt a sampling-based approximation. For each task, one episode is randomly sampled for training, while its advantage is computed using all available episodes in the group. In this process, setup tasks and main tasks are treated as distinct, independent task instances, and sampling is performed separately for each task. Due to the dependency between setup and main tasks, not all attempts result in valid episodes, and multiple trials for a given task may yield only a limited number of episodes. In particular, when all episodes for a given task have identical rewards or when only a single episode is available, the reward variance becomes zero, making advantage estimation ill-defined. To address this issue, we exclude episode groups with zero reward variance from policy optimization. This approach reduces computational overhead by reusing previously collected episodes rather than generating new rollouts at every training step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不再对一个组内所有回合计算期望，而是采用基于采样的近似方法。 对于每个任务，随机采样一个回合用于训练，而其优势则使用该组中所有可用的回合来计算。 在此过程中，准备任务与主任务被视为相互独立的任务实例，并对每个任务分别进行采样。 由于准备任务与主任务之间存在依赖关系，并非所有尝试都能产生有效回合，且针对某一任务的多次尝试可能只产生数量有限的回合。 特别地，当某一任务的所有回合具有完全相同的奖励，或仅存在单个回合时，奖励方差为零，导致优势估计不适定。 为解决这一问题，我们将奖励方差为零的回合组从策略优化中排除。 这种方法通过复用先前收集的回合，而不是在每次训练步骤中生成新的推演，从而降低了计算开销。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks and applications. We evaluate MAGE on the OSWorld benchmark ( Xie et al., 2024 ) for five applications: LibreOffice Calc, Impress, and Writer, GIMP, and VSCode. These applications require diverse multi-step GUI interactions including spreadsheet editing, slide modification, document editing, image editing, and code-related operations. Since OSWorld is a widely used CUA benchmark, tasks on these applications may already be in CUA training data. To examine whether MAGE can also adapt CUAs to applications with potentially limited coverage in their training, we construct 30 new evaluation tasks for Slack, a workplace communication platform.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试与应用。 我们在 OSWorld 基准测试（Xie et al., 2024）上评估 MAGE，涵盖五个应用：LibreOffice Calc、Impress、Writer、GIMP 和 VSCode。 这些应用需要多样化的多步图形用户界面交互，包括电子表格编辑、幻灯片修改、文档编辑、图像编辑和代码相关操作。 由于 OSWorld 是一个被广泛使用的 CUA 基准测试，这些应用上的任务可能已经存在于 CUA 的训练数据中。 为了检验 MAGE 是否也能将 CUA 适配到其训练数据中覆盖可能有限的应用，我们为 Slack（一个职场沟通平台）构建了 30 个新的评估任务。

paragraphs.en: OSWorld. As shown in Table 1 , MAGE consistently improves performance across all five applications and both backbone models. To assess the statistical significance of the overall success rate improvement, we conduct a two-sided Welch’s t-test. The improvements are statistically significant for both UI-TARS-1.5 ( p = 4.13 × 10 − 4 p=4.13\times 10^{-4} ) and EvoCUA ( p = 3.63 × 10 − 4 p=3.63\times 10^{-4} ). Notable improvements are observed in Calc and VSCode, with gains of 19.57 %p for UI-TARS-1.5 on Calc and 10.43%p for EvoCUA on VSCode. Many tasks in Calc and VSCode can be performed using keyboard shortcuts or application-specific commands, potentially reducing the need for complex menu navigation. We hypothesize that MAGE benefits from retrieving these procedures from user manuals and incorporating them into its plans, helping agents execute tasks more effectively.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , MAGE improves the success rate on Slack by 22.66%p and 18.66%p for UI-TARS-1.5 and EvoCUA, respectively. Both improvements are statistically significant under a two-sided Welch’s t-test over five independent runs ( p = 0.0094 p=0.0094 and p = 0.0035 p=0.0035 , respectively). Notably, these gains are larger than those observed on OSWorld for both backbones. The relatively low performance of both backbone models on Slack may reflect limited exposure to Slack-specific tasks during training. Although their exact training data coverage is unknown, Slack is absent from several widely used CUA benchmarks. By leveraging user manuals for planning and policy optimization, MAGE may compensate for this lack of application-specific training experience, leading to larger performance gains on Slack. These results suggest its potential for adapting to new applications with limited prior training data.

paragraphs.en: We conduct an ablation study to evaluate the contributions of MAGE’s two key components: Retrieval-augmented Planning (RAP) during execution and Policy Optimization (PO) during training. paragraphs.en: To quantify the resources required to adapt MAGE to a new application, we analyze the adaptation cost when using UI-TARS-1.5 as the base agent, as summarized in Table 4 . Specifically, we measure the monetary API cost, the wall-clock times required for episode generation, and policy optimization. paragraphs.en: We presented MAGE, a framework that leverages user manuals for both task execution with manual-guided planning and training with manual-derived tasks. In the execution pipeline, MAGE retrieves task-relevant manual sections and uses a planner to generate a plan conditioned on the task instruction and the initial screen state. The generated plan is provided to CUAs, together with the task instruction and trajectory history, allowing them to incorporate external procedural knowledge during action generation. In the training pipeline, MAGE constructs manual-derived tasks from function-level manual sections, collects self-generated trajectories in the GUI environment, assigns rewards through an automatic evaluator, and performs GRPO-based policy optimization. This design integrates manual-based task construction, agent–environment interaction, reward assignment, and policy optimization without requiring human-authored expert demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MAGE，一个利用用户手册的框架，既用于基于手册引导规划的任务执行，也用于基于手册派生任务的训练。 在执行流程中，MAGE 检索与任务相关的手册章节，并使用规划器根据任务指令和初始屏幕状态生成计划。 生成的计划会连同任务指令和轨迹历史一起提供给 CUA（计算机使用智能体），使其在动作生成过程中能够融合外部程序性知识。 在训练流程中，MAGE 从功能级手册章节构建手册派生任务，在 GUI 环境中收集自生成的轨迹，通过自动评估器分配奖励，并执行基于 GRPO 的策略优化。 该设计整合了基于手册的任务构建、智能体—环境交互、奖励分配和策略优化，且无需人工编写的专家演示。

paragraphs.en: This work aims to reduce the human demonstration effort required to adapt computer-using agents to target applications. Such agents may also cause unintended operations, data loss, or unauthorized actions. Our experiments evaluate task execution in designated test environments; the results do not establish safe deployment in unrestricted settings. Practical deployment should incorporate restricted permissions, user confirmation for sensitive actions, and appropriate logging. The safeguards discussed here are deployment recommendations rather than guarantees provided by our method.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作旨在减少将使用计算机的智能体适配到目标应用所需的人类示范工作量。 此类智能体还可能导致意外操作、数据丢失或未经授权的行为。 我们的实验在指定的测试环境中评估任务执行情况；其结果并不能证明在不受限制的环境中的安全部署。 实际部署应包含受限权限、对敏感操作的用户确认以及适当的日志记录。 本文讨论的保障措施是部署建议，而非我们方法所提供的保证。

paragraphs.en: The main text and appendix describe the task-generation procedure, retrieval-augmented planning, policy optimization, and evaluation protocols. The appendix provides prompt templates, training configurations, action spaces, and additional analyses. paragraphs.en: This section describes the construction of the Slack test set and evaluates the robustness of our results to task structure.

paragraphs.en: To minimize potential bias toward the training data, we construct the Slack test set independently of the user manuals used for training. We define 30 evaluation tasks across 15 functional themes, including messaging, channel management, and workspace administration. For tasks requiring an initial setup, we use GPT-5.4 to construct corresponding setup tasks. The resulting test set consists of 18 main-only tasks and 12 setup–main task pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了尽量减少对训练数据的潜在偏差，我们在构建 Slack 测试集时独立于用于训练的用户手册。 我们在 15 个功能主题（包括消息传递、频道管理和工作区管理）上定义了 30 个评估任务。 对于需要初始设置的任务，我们使用 GPT-5.4 构建相应的设置任务。 最终的测试集包含 18 个仅主任务和 12 组设置–主任务对。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a human validation study to assess the reliability of the LLM-generated supervision used in MAGE. Specifically, we examine three components: generated tasks, manual-guided plans, and trajectory evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项人工验证研究，以评估 MAGE 中所使用的由大语言模型生成的监督信号的可靠性。 具体而言，我们考察了三个组成部分：生成的任务、人工指导的计划以及轨迹评估。

sents.en: We conduct a human validation study to assess the reliability of the LLM-generated supervision used in MAGE.
sents.zh: 我们进行了一项人工验证研究，以评估 MAGE 中所使用的由大语言模型生成的监督信号的可靠性。

sents.en: Specifically, we examine three components: generated tasks, manual-guided plans, and trajectory evaluation.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们考察了三个组成部分：生成的任务、人工指导的计划以及轨迹评估。

paragraphs.en: We manually inspect 150 generated tasks, including 50 tasks each from Calc, Impress, and Writer. Each task is evaluated according to three binary criteria:
paragraphs.zh: 我们人工检查了150个生成的任务，其中包括来自 Calc、Impress 和 Writer 各50个任务。 每个任务根据三个二元标准进行评估：

sents.en: We manually inspect 150 generated tasks, including 50 tasks each from Calc, Impress, and Writer.
sents.zh: 我们人工检查了150个生成的任务，其中包括来自 Calc、Impress 和 Writer 各50个任务。

sents.en: Each task is evaluated according to three binary criteria:
sents.zh: 每个任务根据三个二元标准进行评估：

paragraphs.en: Usefulness: whether the task corresponds to a meaningful operation that a real user may perform.
paragraphs.zh: 实用性：任务是否对应真实用户可能执行的有意义操作。

paragraphs.en: Feasibility: whether the instruction is sufficiently specified and executable in the given environment.
paragraphs.zh: 可行性：指令是否已被充分指定，并且能够在给定环境中执行。

paragraphs.en: Visual verifiability: whether successful task completion can be determined from the resulting screenshots.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉可验证性：能否从最终截图判断任务是否成功完成。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 10 , 93.3% of the generated tasks are judged useful, and all tasks are visually verifiable. The feasibility rate is lower at 84.0%, with the remaining cases primarily involving ambiguous instructions or missing prerequisites, such as required files or objects. These results show that the generation process produces largely meaningful and visually verifiable tasks, while also motivating the use of filtering before episode generation to remove infeasible instances.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 10 所示，93.3% 的生成任务被判定为有用，且所有任务均可通过视觉验证。 可行性率较低，为 84.0%，其余未通过的情况主要涉及指令含糊或缺少前提条件，例如所需的文件或物体。 这些结果表明，生成过程能够产生大体上有意义且可视觉验证的任务，同时也说明有必要在生成回合之前先进行过滤，以剔除不可行的实例。

sents.en: As shown in Table 10 , 93.3% of the generated tasks are judged useful, and all tasks are visually verifiable.
sents.zh: 如表 10 所示，93.3% 的生成任务被判定为有用，且所有任务均可通过视觉验证。

sents.en: The feasibility rate is lower at 84.0%, with the remaining cases primarily involving ambiguous instructions or missing prerequisites, such as required files or objects.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the quality of manual-guided plans on OSWorld Calc using four criteria: requirement coverage (covering key task requirements), procedural correctness (following a valid procedure), executability (being actionable in the environment), and scope safety (avoiding unnecessary actions). Minor correctable errors are tolerated, while missing essential steps or task-blocking errors are considered failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步在 OSWorld Calc 上使用四项标准评估人工引导计划的质量：需求覆盖（涵盖关键任务需求）、过程正确性（遵循有效流程）、可执行性（在环境中可实际操作）以及范围安全性（避免不必要的操作）。 轻微的可纠正错误可以被容忍，而缺失关键步骤或阻碍任务完成的错误则被视为失败。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 11 , a plan is considered helpful if it satisfies requirement coverage and at least two of the remaining three criteria. Under this definition, 70.21% of the generated plans are helpful, indicating that most plans capture the task objective without introducing substantial out-of-scope actions.

paragraphs.en: To validate the VLM-based evaluator, we measured its agreement with OSWorld’s rule-based evaluation functions.
